name: Gumbo with Chicken and Sausage
steps: Brown the chicken and sausage in oil and set aside.
Soften the onion, pepper, celery and garlic in the same pot.
Add the broth, tomatoes, okra, seasoning and meats and simmer 35 minutes.
Serve over the rice.

name: Seafood Gumbo with Shrimp and Crab
steps: Soften the onion, pepper, celery and garlic in oil.
Add the broth, tomatoes, okra and seasoning and simmer 25 minutes.
Add the shrimp and crab for the last 5 minutes.

name: Crawfish-Style Shrimp Étouffée
steps: Soften the onion, pepper, celery and garlic in butter.
Stir in the paste, broth and seasoning and simmer 12 minutes.
Add the shrimp and cook 4 minutes.
Serve over rice with green onion.

name: Blackened Chicken with Dirty Cauliflower Rice
steps: Coat the chicken in Cajun seasoning and sear in oil, 5 minutes a side.
Brown the turkey with the onion, pepper and celery and add the cauliflower rice.
Serve the sliced chicken over the rice with green onion.

name: Louisiana Red Rice with Smoked Sausage
steps: Brown the sliced sausage in oil.
Add the onion, pepper, celery and garlic and soften.
Stir in the paste, broth and seasoning, then the cooked rice, and heat through.

name: Hoppin' John with Black-Eyed Peas
steps: Simmer the peas with the ham, onion, celery, pepper, garlic and broth for 30 minutes.
Serve over the rice with hot sauce.

name: Smothered Chicken Thighs with Onion Gravy
steps: Season and sear the chicken in oil, then set aside.
Cook the onions slowly in the pan until deep golden.
Add the broth, thyme and arrowroot slurry and simmer to a gravy.
Return the chicken and braise 20 minutes; serve with green beans.

name: Southern Pan-Fried Catfish with Slaw
steps: Dip the catfish in egg, then almond flour mixed with parmesan and seasoning.
Pan-fry in oil 4 minutes a side.
Toss the slaw with yogurt and vinegar and serve alongside.

name: Shrimp Po' Boy Lettuce Boats
steps: Season the shrimp and sear in oil 2 minutes a side.
Mix the mayo, hot sauce and lemon.
Fill the lettuce leaves with shrimp, tomato, pickle and sauce.

name: Oyster Po' Boy on a Bun
steps: Dip the oysters in egg, then almond flour and seasoning.
Pan-fry in oil until golden, about 2 minutes a side.
Toast the buns and fill with oysters, lettuce, tomato and mayo.

name: Cajun Chicken Pasta
steps: Sear the seasoned chicken in oil and slice.
Soften the pepper, mushrooms and garlic.
Add the cream and parmesan and simmer 3 minutes.
Toss with the pasta and chicken.

name: Creole Shrimp and Okra Stew
steps: Soften the onion, pepper and garlic in oil.
Add the okra, tomatoes and seasoning and simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the shrimp and cook 4 minutes.

name: Collard Greens with Smoked Turkey Wing Style
steps: Crisp the bacon with onion and garlic.
Add the chopped collards, broth and pepper flakes.
Simmer 45 minutes and finish with vinegar.

name: Fried Okra, Oven-Baked
steps: Slice the okra.
Dip in egg, then the almond flour mix.
Roast on an oiled tray at 425°F for 25 minutes, turning once.

name: Southern Cabbage and Sausage Skillet
steps: Brown the sliced sausage in oil.
Add the onion and garlic, then the cabbage and broth.
Cook covered 15 minutes and finish with vinegar.

name: Black-Eyed Pea Salad (Texas Caviar)
steps: Combine the peas, corn, pepper, onion and jalapeno.
Dress with vinegar, oil and lime and fold in cilantro.
Chill an hour before serving.

name: Southern Chicken Salad with Pecans and Apple
steps: Shred the chicken and mix with celery, apple and pecans.
Bind with yogurt, mayo, mustard and lemon.
Serve over the greens.

name: Tomato Pie-Style Baked Tomatoes
steps: Slice the tomatoes and layer in a dish.
Mix the cheeses, mayo and basil and spread on top.
Bake at 375°F for 25 minutes.

name: Pimento-Style Cheese Celery Boats
steps: Mix the grated cheddar, cream cheese, chopped red pepper, mayo and seasoning.
Fill celery stalks.

name: Georgia Peach Cottage Cheese Cup
steps: Spoon the cottage cheese into cups.
Top with sliced peach, pecans, cinnamon and vanilla.

name: Low-Country Boil
steps: Bring the water to a boil with Old Bay, lemon, onion and garlic.
Add the potatoes and cook 10 minutes, then the sausage and corn for 8.
Add the shrimp for the last 3 minutes and drain.

name: She-Crab-Style Soup (Lightened)
steps: Soften the onion and celery in butter.
Add the broth and milk and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in the crab, Old Bay and lemon and heat gently.

name: Carolina Pulled Pork Plate with Vinegar Slaw
steps: Use cooked, shredded pork shoulder; toss with half the vinegar, pepper flakes, paprika and salt.
Toss the slaw with the rest of the vinegar and the oil.
Serve the pork with slaw and boiled potatoes.

name: Southern Green Beans with New Potatoes
steps: Crisp the bacon with the onion.
Add the beans, potatoes and broth.
Simmer covered 30 minutes.

name: Deviled Egg Salad Stuffed Tomatoes
steps: Hard-boil the eggs and chop.
Mix with yogurt, mustard, celery and chives.
Hollow out the tomatoes and fill; dust with paprika.

name: Chicken and Sausage Jambalaya Soup
steps: Simmer the chicken, onion, pepper and celery in the broth and tomatoes for 20 minutes.
Shred the chicken, add the sliced sausage, rice and seasoning and cook 8 minutes.

name: Cajun Shrimp Stuffed Avocado
steps: Season the shrimp and sear in oil, 2 minutes a side.
Halve the avocados.
Fill with shrimp, onion and cilantro and squeeze lime on top.

name: Peach Pecan Overnight Oats
steps: Stir the oats, milk, yogurt, chia and cinnamon in a jar.
Refrigerate overnight.
Top with peach and pecans.
